Data issue: Missing component values where the published totals identify them as zero
How it is handled: Structural zeros (every published total containing the value adds up without it); logged; nothing else filled

Data issue: Published residence total differs from the component sum
How it is handled: System total = component sum A+B+D+E+F; the published total is scored with the forecast divided by (1 - d)

Data issue: E(World) + F(World) differs from G(World) by about 0.1%
How it is handled: Discrepancy node DELTA_INT; in reconciliation the ratio r = DELTA_INT / G(World) enters the balance row

Data issue: OECD aggregate is not the sum of its members (territory)

How it is handled: flag_sep2025: every evaluation with and without it

Data issue: 2022 domestic/international episode, 2021-12 to 2022-10: World international share 74.1% (same months a year earlier) to 65.5% (minimum 64.4% in 2022-06); B = C +188 kt/day, F -167, G -173; World totals +2.5%
How it is handled: Documented (DATA_RULES.md, Fig. 1); 11 of the 13 long-horizon origins (2021-12 to 2022-12) lie inside it, which affects the reading of the skill estimates for components and territory measures; diagnostic skill of the totals in results/episode_2022/skill_totals.csv
Main evaluation window ends 2025-12; 2026-01 to 2026-06 is a separate stress test

Data issue: Series that are zero for two years
How it is handled: Fixed at zero at that origin, still scored

Data issue: Switzerland: A, B, F unpublished for 2025
How it is handled: Outside the system; published residence total forecast as an outside-system series

Data issue: Territory assignment of ports (e.g. Malaysia high, Hong Kong low)
How it is handled: Not handled; reported as a limitation (DATA_RULES.md)

Data issue: Components published to 2026-06, residence totals to 2026-09
How it is handled: The test at origin 2026-06 scores the published residence totals of 2026-07 to 2026-09
